name: slack_read_channel
description: This tool allows you to read recent message history from a Slack channel, newest first, including thread parent messages but not their replies. Use this tool to catch up on a discussion or find a specific message. History access is limited by the workspace plan retention window. Bot and app messages are included and marked with their bot_id so you can distinguish them from human messages.

channel.title: Channel reference
channel.description: Reference to a Slack conversation. Provide either the channel id (preferred, stable across renames) or the human-readable channel name.

channel_id.description: The unique conversation id, e.g. C0123456789. Stable across channel renames.

channel_name.description: Human readable channel name without the leading hash sign.

oldest.description: Only return messages after this Unix timestamp, e.g. 1719430000.000000.

pagination.title: Pagination options
pagination.description: Standard cursor-based pagination controls shared by every list endpoint in this server.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned in the previous page of results. Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Number of items to return per page. The server clamps values above the maximum.
